name: io.github.chrischall/zola-mcp
description: Zola wedding planning for Claude — vendors, budget, guests, seating, registry, and RSVPs

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Zola refresh token JWT (~1 year lifetime). Optional — when unset, the MCP falls back to the ContextMint Bridge browser extension to read the `usr` cookie from your signed-in zola.com tab, and caches it so later starts need no browser.

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to opt out of the fetchproxy browser fallback (headless / CI). With it set and no ZOLA_REFRESH_TOKEN, auth is a hard error unless a previous bootstrap already cached a token — reading that file is not opening a browser, so the cache stays readable.

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_TOKEN_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'false' to disable the on-disk refresh-token cache and ask the browser on every start. Defaults to enabled. Inert when ZOLA_REFRESH_TOKEN is set — there is no bootstrap to skip.

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path for the refresh-token cache file. Defaults to $MCP_DATA_DIR/.zola-mcp/refresh-token.json, else the same path under $HOME.

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the account id normally read from GET /v3/users/me/context. Set it only to pin a specific account.

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_REGISTRY_ID
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the registry id normally read from the same context call.

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_WEDDING_ID
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the wedding id normally read from the same context call.

environmentVariables.name: ZOLA_SESSION_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A seed session token (JWT). The client refreshes it about five minutes before its exp, so this is a starting point rather than a long-lived credential.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Localhost port of the fetchproxy concentrator the ContextMint Bridge extension connects to (default 37149). Every MCP on one machine shares it, so move it for all of them or not at all.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator, a literal IP only (default 127.0.0.1). Keep on loopback; it exists for hosted deployments that run each MCP in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where the fetchproxy long-term identity keypair is stored (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/).
